generalAbilities.name: Scent (Imprecise) 200 feet
generalAbilities.description:
See rules...

Scent involves sensing creatures or objects by smell, and is usually a vague sense. The range is listed in the ability, and it functions only if the creature or object being detected emits an aroma (for instance, incorporeal creatures usually do not exude an aroma).

If a creature emits a heavy aroma or is upwind, the GM can double or even triple the range of scent abilities used to detect that creature, and the GM can reduce the range if a creature is downwind.

generalAbilities.name: Voice of Nature
generalAbilities.description: Though the Wardens of the Wild do not speak in words, they can communicate complex concepts flawlessly and wordlessly with any animal, beast, plant, or other creature of the natural world through prolonged eye contact. Sapient creatures with strong ties to the natural world, such as animal instinct barbarians or druids who speak the Wildsong, can somewhat understand a Warden of the Wild, though the meaning can be vague.

generalAbilities.name: Warden's Crown
generalAbilities.description: A Warden of the Wild's horned crown commands respect from wild creatures. Wild creatures native to a warden's biome automatically improve their attitude toward it by one step (up to friendly) and typically do not take hostile actions towards each other while in the warden's presence.

defensiveAbilities.name: Bioluminescent Maelstrom
defensiveAbilities.description:
30 feet DC 45 Will Saving Throw

The warden's wrath conjures a dazzling storm around them that makes the area difficult terrain. Creatures that enter the storm must attempt a Will save. A creature that succeeds at this save is temporarily immune to the luring visuals for 24 hours.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is Dazzled for 1 round, and for the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to move as close to the warden as possible.

Critical Failure The creature is dazzled for as long as it remains in the aura. Whenever the creature begins its turn within the aura, the creature must use the first action of its turn to move as close to the warden as possible. It can attempt a new save at the end of its turn, ending this effect on a success.

offensiveAbilities.name: All Are One
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per turn

Effect The warden attracts organisms that extend their influence. The area of bioluminescent maelstrom and the reach of their tentacle Strike increase by 10 feet for 1 minute, to a maximum of an additional 30 feet.

offensiveAbilities.name: Arctic Embrace
offensiveAbilities.description: All creatures in the warden's bioluminescent maelstrom take 10d6 Cold Damage damage (Basic DC 45 Fortitude Saving Throw save). On a failure, the creature is also Slowed 1 for 1 round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grasp of the Deep
offensiveAbilities.description:
Creatures struck by one of the warden's tentacles gain cold weakness 10 and take a –2 status penalty to Fortitude saves for 1 round.

Effect: Grasp of the Deep

offensiveAbilities.name: I Am The Tide
offensiveAbilities.description: The warden creates three lines of rushing water, each 10 feet wide and 120 feet long. Creatures in the area take 18d8 Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 45 Fortitude Saving Throw save). The warden can either push or pull, and all creatures that fail this save move up to 40 feet in the direction chosen. The warden can't use I Am The Tide again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: What Lurks Beneath
offensiveAbilities.description: The warden attacks with their tentacles six times.
